acquisition_method.evidence: MS/MS spectra were acquired in data-dependent acquisition mode at top speed for 3 s per cycle; the AGC target was set to 1E4 with a maximum injection time of 35 ms.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: Proteins were reduced with 10 mM DTT for 1 h at 56 °C and alkylated with 20 mM iodoacetic acid for 30 min at RT in the dark.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Proteins were reduced with 10 mM DTT for 1 h at 56 °C and alkylated with 20 mM iodoacetic acid for 30 min at RT in the dark.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Free trypsin was added to the protein solution at a trypsin:protein ratio of 1:50 and incubated overnight at 37 °C.

collision_energy.evidence: Ions were subjected to stepped-energy higher-energy collision dissociation fragmentation at a normalized collision energy of 20 ± 5%.

fragmentation_method.evidence: Ions were subjected to stepped-energy higher-energy collision dissociation fragmentation at a normalized collision energy of 20 ± 5%.

ionization_type.evidence: Proteomics data were acquired via LC-MS/MS using an UltiMate 3000 UHPLC (Thermo Fisher Scientific), coupled in line with an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) with an ESI nanospray source.

mass_analyzer.evidence: inferred: Survey (MS) scans were acquired in Orbitrap (FT) with automated gain control (AGC) target 8E5, maximum injection time 50 ms, and dynamic exclusion of 30 s across the scan range of 375 to 1800 m/z.
